detailZones.title: Monitor and arm
detailZones.description: Inspect the blank monitor, frame, articulated arm, mounting plate and visible cable-routing parts.

detailZones.title: Desktop inputs and dock
detailZones.translation: 桌面输入设备与扩展坞
detailZones.description: Follow the blank laptop, docking station, keyboard, keypad, mouse, document holder and desk accessories.

detailZones.title: Desk surface and storage
detailZones.description: Inspect the work surface, rounded edges, desk legs, modesty panel and closed drawer pedestal.

detailZones.title: Chair and ergonomics
detailZones.translation: 办公椅与人体工学部件
detailZones.description: Explore the mesh task chair, lumbar support, armrests, adjustment hardware, five-star base and casters.

detailZones.title: Under-desk cables and power
detailZones.description: Follow the under-desk cable tray, riser, basket, power strip, floor box, clips and routed leads.

detailZones.title: Room lighting and floor
detailZones.description: Inspect the window wall, privacy fabric, plant trough, coat stand, ceiling services, wall finish and floor.

anchorAudit.rationale: The source and resized workstation photographs were inspected at native and final pixels. This batch retains 150 independently pointable desktop, monitor, input-device, chair, storage, cable-management, lighting, plant and floor parts across 6 bounded zones. Employee identity, company identity, screen content, network status, private documents, company policy, personal data and inferred productivity were excluded.
